convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'BuySell' custom indicator, and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position open/close logic. Custom indicator buffers must be replicated in Python.

other_exits: Sell position closed on UpTrend signal when SellPosClose=true; Buy position closed on DnTrend signal when BuyPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative MM value = fixed lot size (0.1 lots); positive MM value = deposit fraction for deal sizing

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses BuySell custom indicator with two buffers: buffer 1 = UpTrend (buy signal line), buffer 0 = DnTrend (sell signal line). Buy signal: UpTrend[0] is non-zero AND DnTrend[1] was non-zero on previous bar (trend flip from down to up). Sell signal: DnTrend[0] is non-zero AND UpTrend[1] was non-zero on previous bar (trend flip from up to down). Entry permissions are gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen booleans. Exit permissions are gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans. Recount flag ensures signal recalculation on data errors. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen gates determine if new positions can be opened; BuyPosClose/SellPosClose gates determine if opposite-side signal closes existing positions.
python_conversion_notes: The BuySell custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or re-implemented in Python. It takes MA_Period, MA_Method, MA_Price, ATR_Period as inputs and outputs two buffers (UpTrend, DnTrend). TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles position open/close with SL/TP in points, deviation checks, and lot sizing logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction). The BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions use SignalTime to avoid duplicate entries on the same bar. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - verify if digit adjustment is needed for 5-digit brokers. The new-bar guard and Recount mechanism must be replicated to prevent repeated signals within the same bar.
